body: The ground around the footprints was still warm from recent steps, but I hesitated before bending down to investigate. The prints were faint yet clear, leading straight toward the center of the yard where sunlight streamed through tall trees on one side and cast shadows on another. My initial impulse to shield myself seemed misplaced; instead, I felt compelled to understand my surroundings better. I took slow, deliberate steps forward, keeping an eye on every detail as if I might need it later for identification purposes. I could hear birds chirping peacefully nearby, which calmed me further. As I got closer, the footprints led into soft grass, then crossed over uneven terrain towards a small patch of flowers hidden beneath leaves. My heart raced slightly with curiosity but also a sense of responsibility to find out who these mysterious visitors were.
